pages.text: §bWelcome to the world of Forgeborne Odyssey!§r$(br2)This tutorial will guide you through the §dcountless wisdom of human ingenuity§r — from §dChalcolithic§r stone tool crafting, to cold forging, fire-crack mining, and pottery firing, witnessing how our ancestors worked alongside nature with their own hands.$(br2)Follow these steps carefully; these ancient crafts may save your life when it matters most.

pages.title: What You Will Learn
pages.text: $(li)§6Chapter 1§r: Crafting Stone Tools - Your first tools$(br)$(li)§6Chapter 2§r: Finding Natural Metals - Copper, Silver, Gold$(br)$(li)§6Chapter 3§r: Cold Forging Basics - From billet to blade$(br)$(li)§6Chapter 4§r: Fire-Crack Mining - Efficient ore extraction$(br)$(li)§6Chapter 5§r: Pottery Making - Kiln building and firing

pages.title: Before You Begin
pages.text: This mod completely changes the early game progression.$(br2)$(li)§cNo wooden/stone pickaxe can mine ores!§r$(br)$(li)You must find §6natural metal blocks§r on the surface$(br)$(li)Cold forging replaces traditional smelting$(br)$(li)Fire-crack mining is the only way to get ore chunks$(br)$(li)Pottery requires building and managing a kiln$(br2)$(4)Tip:§r Hold §aShift§r to view detailed item information.
